connector.name: MCP by wontopos.com
connector.registryDescription: Wontopos (WOS) long-term memory (beta) - one memory across Claude Code, Cursor, and your agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package wontopos-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.wontopos, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: WONTOPOS_API_KEY
env.description: Wontopos API key (wos-live-...). Create one in the console at wontopos.com.

env.name: WONTOPOS_USER_ID
env.description: Default store for every tool call (default: "default").

env.name: WONTOPOS_MODEL
env.description: Engine to read with: tablet-1 (default) or scroll-1.

env.name: WONTOPOS_READ_ONLY
env.description: Set to 1 for read-only mode: recall/search/list_memories/engram/stats only, no write or delete tools.

env.name: WONTOPOS_ALLOW_STORE_OVERRIDE
env.description: Set to 1 to let tools take a user_id argument (multi-store). Default: every call is pinned to WONTOPOS_USER_ID.
